diagnosis.reference: On leaf1, interface ethernet-1/1 lost its IPv4 address: 10.255.0.1/31 was removed, so the interface has no address on the fabric_l1_s1 segment.

arguments.name: ethernet-1/1.0
arguments.reason: leaf1-ethernet-1/1.0 is up and in the default instance but has no IPv4 address, while its peer spine1-ethernet-1/1 is 10.255.0.0/31. spine1's to-leaf1 next-hop-group points at 10.255.0.1 and leaf1's to-leaf2 group points at 10.255.0.0; both are unusable without the /31 on leaf1, and traffic ECMP'd leaf2->spine1->leaf1 is dropped (web1->user1 and app1->user1 100% loss while guest1->user1 works). Adding 10.255.0.1/31 restores the intended link.

action.command: set / interface ethernet-1/1 subinterface 0 ipv4 address 10.255.0.1/31
